request.subject: UNIT:ICE_FOLK:PATROL_BOAT

layers.text: Turn it into an ice-age longship: the pale hull becomes dark brown-grey hide over wood, colour #493736 with #2d2b2b shadows, with a white fur trim along the rail; the bow rises into a tall clear bright ice-blue crystal figurehead; the red sail becomes a sail of shaggy warm white fur, colour #e3d5b7 shaded warm taupe #8c7667, never blue-grey; the pennant becomes a white fur tail. Keep the mast, boat shape, size, thick black outline and style exactly the same, with nothing under the hull.
